Tara (ruby-sdk): quick note: a customer hit a confusing error during onboarding — our Ruby SDK retries on 401 but doesn't attempt to obtain a fresh token, so the sample app shows repeated failures.
Ben (devex): hmm that's unfortunate. Do we document token rotation anywhere?
Tara (ruby-sdk): not in the sampleapp quickstart. It assumes long-lived API keys. Trials now hand out short-lived tokens which expire during interactive demos.
Kaya (qa): I reproduced locally: start with token, revoke from dashboard, second request -> SDK rescues Unauthorized, retries once, still 401 -> raises. Tests didn't catch it because we stubbed HTTP.
Ben (devex): seems we should do three things: update quickstart, add an opt-in token refresh hook to the SDK, and add a helpful error message when no hook is set.
Tara (ruby-sdk): my proposed API: Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ..., token_refresh: -> { AuthService.get_new_token }) The retry middleware would call the hook once on 401 and retry.
Kaya (qa): for CI I can add an integration that uses a mock auth server to simulate rotation so we cover the path without external org revokes.
Actions Bot: GitHub Actions started for branch tara/token-refresh.
Ben (devex): please also add a changelog entry and a short snippet in the sampleapp README showing the hook. That will reduce support noise.
Tara (ruby-sdk): will open two PRs: docs(sampleapp): add short-lived token guidance, and feat(ruby-sdk): optional token_refresh hook. I'll ping when ready.
Kaya (qa): once PRs land I'll add the mock-compose fixture and CI matrix job.
Actions Bot: GitHub Actions passed for tara/token-refresh (smoke + unit) :white_check_mark:
Ben (devex): thanks all, great faster follow-up.
Tara (ruby-sdk): posting PR links now.
